name: enum-group-conversion
description: A member of an enumerated type that no source names, before a member a source names, is retained by the enum-group class when a value of the type is produced by a conversion from a number, because a value can then arrive by number rather than by name and deleting the member renumbers the named one. A member of an enumerated type no conversion produces, that no source names, is reported as an unused enum member.
